arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Hagler stated that uninsured people pay more for drugs.
He noted that cash-paying patients are least able to absorb high prices.
Mr. Phillips addressed the Court regarding the legal basis of the case.
Chief Justice Rehnquist questioned whether adverse consequences are factually unresolved.
